configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Matches the clang++ path sd build already resolves to, with CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug. Uses its own tree, build/preset-debug, so it never touches the trees sd builds.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Matches the clang++ path sd build already resolves to, with CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release. Uses its own tree, build/preset-release, so it never touches the trees sd builds.
